steps.name: Leaving Glaston...
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Sylvia] in “Glaston Central Square.”

steps.name: There is no road now
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Sylvia] in 「Glaston Central Square」, and use the portal to 「Oscar Road」 to go inside.
2. Report the quest to [Mandarava] in the scenario dungeon “Foggy Oscar Road.”

lines.text: (The moment Adventurer comes down from the street north of the square with Leticia and heads toward the square, many soldiers appear from nowhere and come into view.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, stop for a moment. I can't defeat all the soldiers... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … How do we go from here… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, by the way, do you know the way to Oscar Road?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Didn’t Leti know?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I know there is such a road, but I don't know where it goes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do... . The first thing to do is to get out... .
(First, a girl with long red hair appears in front of the two people who were hiding behind the building.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: There, Letty and %s. fizzle.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh! This is Sylvia, who is clinking.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Letty, you said it wasn't like that. You also like to take a break from work, so why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Then, are you trying to catch %s?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Even if I catch him, he's not the kind of person who would be caught. But the current situation... . Isn't it a little strange?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: The reason the soldiers were trying to catch %s was because they were plotting to kill His Majesty... . Adventurer can't do that.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right. But why is Sylvia normal?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'm always normal... . Letty, what does that mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia, I'm sorry. It's quite long to explain that... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: We have to go to Oscar Road.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: … no way… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia, do you know something?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Please follow me. I'll go and tell you.
(Fortunately or not, the soldiers and knights in the square leave for another place.)
(Adventurer and Leticia, who were examining the situation, follow Silvia and stop in front of a building near the Siren statue.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Wait a minute.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: There's no one around.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Okay. for a moment… .
(Silvia goes back to the back of the building, as if she wants to check something. After a while, she extends her hand and gestures as if to come closer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylvia, what's there?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: If you go back here, there's a road that leads to Oscar Road.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Is there a road to the highway?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Shh. Be quiet. Letty

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there a reason why the road to the highway must be hidden?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: It is said that Oscar Road was the favorite garden of the first emperor. It must have been so beautiful that an area the size of a village was turned into a garden.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I saw in the records that there were a lot of mysterious artifacts, a beautiful lake nearby, and rare flowers and trees growing there.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: There is a story that during the time of His Majesty the 14th Emperor Isnel, many people died there due to demons, so use of it was prohibited.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I don't know if it's because of that or not, but now it's become a place that only people in the know know about.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Because so many people didn't visit and were reluctant to go, they built this building and blocked the road.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, I didn't know.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: After that, I guess the plaza manager will go out and patrol and clean and then come back. Other than that, there are no other people visiting the road... .

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: This is the end of what I have to do. What His Majesty told you is now happening... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you tell me?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: 10 years ago… . Kaina, no. Before His Majesty ascended the throne, He came to me and said something.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I was just so excited to see the beautiful princess, but it must have been quite impressive considering that that moment still lingers in my memory.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: You asked for it because it was your first prediction.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: He said he didn't know when, but someone assisting his Majesty might end up in danger at Glaston, so he said all he had to do was tell me the way to Oscar Road.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: The soldiers of the Council will come after him, Argent will buy us time... You also said… . Really, I never thought the situation would be like this.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Anyway, please be careful. I think I should go and hide in the place my brother mentioned.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I don't know how this situation will end. Still, I hope nothing happens to everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Sylvia.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Then I'll go. Letty, you too be careful.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, I will come back. It's a mission, so I'll do it well.
(Silvia confirms that there is no one around and hurries to run to Lashuette Street.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Nothing should have happened... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Sylvia will be okay. There is a leader. Nothing bad will happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. First, go to the road.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yep!
(As the two people pass along the path that Sylvia showed them, they see large tombstones stuck on a hill.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this Oscar Road starting from here? ? How far should I go... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Just keep going. Hey, I can see the lake over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The lake that Sylvia spoke of… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had no idea there was a place like this near Glaston.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I didn't know because I never went this way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because there seems to be a road over there... … .
(A thick fog rises in front of the two people, who did not know where to go and started at the lake as a starting point.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what... ? suddenly… .
(The fog becomes thicker and fills everything in sight, as if it were bringing in scattered darkness.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I originally heard that water fog often forms near the lake, but this is too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's not regular fog. It looks like someone made it.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s. Please follow me. You can go this way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty? Ah, I found my way to the magic office well.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Leave it to me to find the way. Uh, %s.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: There's something ahead. There's something round floating around, but it doesn't seem to be the Spirit King.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute.
(When Adventurer extends his hand, the hand suddenly goes in as if it is being sucked somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, huh? uh!
What are you? Are you touching me now?

steps.name: foggy road
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Mandalaba] in 「Foggy Oscar Road」, go to the next area of the dungeon through the portal, and collect <Oscar Herb Flower>. 
2. Once outside, defeat [Flying Wood Mimic] in “Oscar Road” and report the quest to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road.”

lines.text: Wow.
(%s's arm, which had been stuck somewhere, comes out with a cheerful sound, as if a closed glass bottle had been opened all at once.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?
(Just when Adventurer was unable to come to his senses, something flew towards him at high speed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nah, it’s late….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… .
(Contrary to the expectation that something hard would fly in, what flew into my face was surprisingly a soft cotton ball.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I'm enjoying this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fluffy?
(Adventurer comes to his senses, removes the thing that jumped at his face, and stares at it.)
You put this down. Don't mistreat me. You put this down. hurry!
(The weed-shaped doll struggles as if it were alive.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, this is… .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, the doll is alive!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you? Is this the doll Circe made?
(The struggling doll stops moving for a moment.)
Circe? I am not a doll made by that evil witch. No!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, he must be angry. Besides, the witch knows!
It's a doll, but it's a herbal spirit. It's a bag of herbs made by a good witch. By the way, stop poking me!
(Leticia pokes a doll she says is a herb spirit with her finger and then laughs.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Sorry. I did it because it was fascinating. This is the second time I see a spirit like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… . So, you, the herb spirit… . I just need to know that it's like a spirit living in a bag of herbs, right?
That's right. that's right. I am the spirit Mandarava.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What were you doing here?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I was playing on Oscar Road. No, I was working. Then I met you two people.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right, %s. let's go

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm not finished talking. It's not over!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava, sorry. We have to go. I don't have time to do this... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's an important story. So, you two, focus on what’s important. Focus!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Even if you walk all day, you can't get there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There... . Did you know I was coming?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I made sure you were the one who could go there. A spirit in charge of such an important task. Ahem.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: If the two of you just go, you'll just keep lingering in the same place in the fog. So you guys listen to me.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, please wait a moment.
(Leticia quickly runs forward with those words. After a while, Leticia, who had disappeared, runs up from behind Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Adventurer was just behind me, but now he's in front... . Sniff.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is what it meant.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: He is a very suspicious person. If you do as I say, you can leave.
(As Mandarava shakes himself off, the zipper opens and a small flower falls out.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Bring me a bunch of Oscar herb flowers right away. It looks like this. You can collect it here.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I'm at a loss, should I give it a try?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava. If you do that, you can really get out, right?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Spirits don't lie. Have you been deceived?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm saying this because I once met a lying spirit. Of course, I was also deceived.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Well, that spirit is bad. I'm not bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. I'll just trust it and give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leti, I'll go to the front and collect. Letty goes to the back and collects.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, the fog is gone!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wow! wow! You found all the medicinal herbs in the fog. I can finally go out! it's okay!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can finally go out? Are you really trapped?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Even monkeys can fall from trees.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Mandarava is a spirit.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Even the herb spirit can't find the herbs. It was a space where you could go out in search of herbs, but suddenly fog appeared and the herbs could not be seen. It was a big deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Fog….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you make this fog by any chance?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Herb spirits don't make things like that. I don't even know how to make it. Anyway, thank you. thanks.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm going to leave now. You guys should go now too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, I have something to ask.
(Mandarava just said those words and floated into the sky. Then, in the gentle wind, it floated somewhere like a fluttering balloon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's an unruly spirit.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, I used my telekinesis to tie the thread to the zipper. Since it flies slowly, I think you can just follow this thread.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well done Letty. Then let's follow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...This place is a little strange. It seems like there are animals and monsters that don't fit together...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now, let’s go without thinking about that….)

steps.name: Glinda the Witch
steps.objective: Talk to [Mandalaba] in “Oscar Road” and defeat [Cooking Chef] and [Trumpet Munchkin]. Then report the quest to [Runo] in “Dorothy Village.”

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I am a perfect herbal spirit that no one can stop. But it got caught on a tree branch.
(The mandarava struggles on a beautifully shining tree.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Who tied this thread to my body? Ah, if I keep struggling like this, the fabric will tear. It shouldn't keep tearing apart... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's dangerous because there are only monsters on Oscar Road. Is there anyone there? Someone please save me! Save the herb spirit!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, I'll save you.
(Mandarava waves happily when he sees Adventurer and Leticia appearing in front of him.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Come to me right away. Cut the string quickly. Do something good that helps me.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's a tone that really doesn't want to be saved.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Your way of speaking is also really strange. What is that? What is it?
(While Adventurer reaches out and grabs the mandaraba hanging from the tree, Leticia uses her telekinesis to cut the strings that bind it.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The human kid's skills are good. good.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thank you for the compliment. Do you know what? I walked this thread.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: … This is why I don’t like little kids… … . Did I tell you that I was coming to pick you up?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Picking you up? Uh, what is that?
(A strange atmosphere of light flows through the trees where the mandarava was hung.)
(Through the light, there is a road leading to a large castle that looks like a ruin.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Emerald castle... .

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What is the castle? What kind of castle do you think is here? The Imperial Castle can be seen from here, but it will be white.
(Just as Adventurer is about to take a step as if being drawn by something, someone's voice is heard.)
Stop there.
(As the owner of the voice places his hand on the sword sheath, a large flash of light unfolds around him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it’s dazzling… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? What happened?
(The road to the emerald castle that was there just a moment ago is no longer visible.)
Are you %s?
(A woman with long black hair comes up and takes her hand out of the sheath. She then lifts her hand fan and fans it to %s, who is sweating coldly.)
I felt an ominous energy flowing through the road. don't worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean? No, who else... You see, right? How do you know me... … .
I am the person who has been asked to look after you by many people, including Iris.
(The woman folds the hand fan she was holding and smiles slightly.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: My name is Glinda. Although she is an elf from Ryosalf, she is also a witch with a troublesome fate.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Since you were sent by Iris, you know that not all witches chase [Night], right? first… .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That's not the story to talk about here. Let's talk in detail in the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, wow. This is my first time seeing that witch.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, who is this kid next to you? I haven't heard of anyone else coming to Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He was the driver who helped me, but I came with him for some reason.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I will never go anywhere and talk about my meeting with the witch. Just believe it once.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You are full of confidence. In that case, I will take it as a promise.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If you do not keep your words and speak carelessly, the people who hear your story will also be in danger.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Is this like a witch's curse?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Think whatever you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda, wait a minute. Leticia... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, this is not your job. It's this kid's choice.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I'm fine. All you have to do is keep the witch’s words.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Child, tell me your name.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's Leticia.
(Glynda nods quietly and taps Leticia on the shoulder with the fan she is holding.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: This is it.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thank you, witch.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then, we will allow you to enter the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm….)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: No need to worry too much. All you have to do is not cause an accident.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Glinda.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, nice to meet you, witch.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Is that how human kids talk these days? It's a way of speaking that becomes addictive after listening to it.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Ah, Mandarava. Tell me what happened and why you were late.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda, listen to me. I wasn't playing. I went out to meet these people to collect medicinal herbs, but fog suddenly appeared and I was trapped.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Fog never appears on Oscar Road. None. There was no fog here even in the twilight... . That person collected medicinal herbs and the fog disappeared. Whoa.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Fog… . no way… … .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Two people. I can't stay on the road for long, so follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Glynda, it looks like you were about to say something... But what does this sound like? It sounds like an instrument being played...)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, what are you doing when you’re not going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Suddenly, I heard sad music coming from somewhere... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: What are you talking about? Collock. Collock. It's probably because of my mood. let's go. Otherwise, I leave it behind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Did I hear something wrong? I can't hear anything...)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: By the way, why did Munchkin Beast, Mimic, and Cooking Spirit come out? I'll have to take him with me as I go. Cool rock, cool rock.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .
(After the group leaves, following Glinda, emerald light flows out from between the trees again.)
(On one side of the emerald castle shining in the faint fog, a woman is staring at the spot they left.)
Glinda… .
You're pretending not to know I'm playing for you... … .

steps.name: Visit to Dorothy's Village
steps.objective: Talk to [Luno] in “Dorothy Village” and say hello to [Vina] and [Elliot] in that order. Then report the quest to [Glinda].

lines.text: (As you walk along the road following Glinda, the scenery you see changes in an instant.)
(The place where the group was was a road that had a view of the lake until a little while ago, but now it is a village on an island in the lake.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Huh? Wow... . Witch, w-what is here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Dorothy’s village.
(The cute building that looks like it was modeled after an animal and the charming atmosphere catch the attention of Adventurer and Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The village was named after a witch who fought against demons in the past. So as not to forget.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: This was the space we discovered while cutting down the demons that were chasing us. It's a strange island in the center of the lake.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy said that it was a place known only to us and that could not be discovered by other beings... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy passed away in an accident, and I came here to pray for her soul to rest in peace.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Somehow, people with unfortunate fates came to me, and seeing as they were not welcome anywhere, I couldn't send them away.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That was the start of what became Dorothy Village today.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy would have wanted that too. Because I always had a desire to make those with unfortunate fates happy, even if only a little.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: As the owner of the village, I greet you again. Welcome to Dorothy Village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your welcome.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The village is so pretty that it looks like a village from a fairy tale.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Yeah? I don't know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I looked at the lake from the road, there was no island or anything… .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You know, it would be similar to that town on another continent. Cut off from the outside, invisible from the outside... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kali village?)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When you leave, just go all the way behind here. It feels like you'll fall into the lake, but don't think about it and just walk away. Then you will have arrived at the highway.
Boss, are you here? The person who said... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, hello. This person here is Runo. Runo, this is %s.
(A deer beast wearing strong armor looks at the group with a cold gaze.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: It's called Runo. Dorothy is in charge of village security. From what the boss said, I thought you were coming alone... .

steps.name: A painful yet sad melody
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road” and enter the place where the fountain is.  
2. Check the story about the performance in front of the fountain, and then return to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava, have you seen Glinda?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda? Have you seen Glinda? I didn't hear Glinda was coming?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So where did Glinda go?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: What's going on? What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda heard the music and came out. Right now, only me and Glinda can hear that music... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oh? uh… .
(The mandarava floats and is caught by %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By any chance, can you hear that sound?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Even if you don’t have spirit ears, you can hear well. I don't know what you're talking about. The sound of birds, the sound of the wind, the sound of music, tell me what it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you hear that playing sound? I can hear it, but why did you pretend not to know?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I never pretended not to know. I just didn't answer because you didn't ask. It was because Glinda didn't like talking about Dorothy.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oops… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothy? I heard he died in an accident... . What, does that mean he's the one playing this song?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava, you know something, right? After hearing this music, strange people came to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They said they were descendants of the black dragon, dragon people.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Ah, no way… . Even if Glinda doesn't like it, there's nothing we can do about it. Let me tell you… . It's not accurate.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: … Dorothy isn't dead? Just listening to the performance makes me want to meet Glinda... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It just feels that way. I don't know the details either. At that time, Dorothy had disappeared and was presumed dead... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth happened?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The music sounds even sadder. It seems like the fog is coming back to the road.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oh, was the fog due to the performance?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even when the music is playing, can you tell where it is coming from? I looked around the street several times, but I couldn't find a place to play.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: There is a tightly closed door in the middle of the street. If you go inside, you might be able to see Dorothy... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: But, I don't know if Glinda is there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that door… .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'll wait here and when I see Glinda, I'll tell her that you went there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s… . Glinda is a little sick. Please don't stay there too long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll go there.
(As Adventurer leaves the spot, emerald light flows from above where Mandarava was standing.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I knew the seal was weakened... . We can't leave it like this... .
(The door, which seemed to be closed tightly and would not open, is gently pushed the moment Adventurer touches it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… .
(The only thing in the space through the door is a fountain and chairs that don't seem to be in use at the moment. Nothing else is visible.)
(However, the lonely performance singing Adventurer continues to be heard without stopping.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know who you are. However, I think the reason I play music like this is because I have something to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How about you show up now?
(At the words of Adventurer, the lonely performance slows down little by little. Then, the bow that strings the strings slips and a sharp sound fills the space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh... I feel like my whole body is being stabbed...)
I didn't mean to tell you this... . Go back… .
(A woman's voice warning in a lonely tone is heard from the end of the space where no one is present except Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's what I heard too. So I need to know.
Go back… . Go back... . I am… , I just need to meet Glinda… … . You can go back!!
(The moment the owner of the voice gets nervous, the bow slips again and a sharp sound hits %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh!
I don't want to hurt you... . However, if you continue to be involved... .
(As the stopped performance is heard again, the movement of the waves that had been swaying due to the wind blowing from the lakeside stops.)
(The movement of the leaves swaying in the wind while hanging on the end of the pillar and fountain also stops. The startled Adventurer steps back, but is blocked as if trapped by an invisible wall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did you create something like a barrier to prevent them from leaving?)
(As I was looking around, the owner of the voice, who had not been seen for a while, slowly walked out from behind the fountain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Big cello….)
(An elf woman with long blonde hair and a light green veil stares somewhere in front of a large stringed instrument.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait a minute... how do I play when my eyes are closed with bandages?)
You're probably wondering how I'm going to play like this... . Don't worry about that.
I won't stop playing until you take my breath away. I already warned you... .
(With the warning from the owner of the voice, the performance becomes more passionate, and the neck of %s trapped here is increasingly tightened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… . Well, stop… .
(Adventurer raises his weapon and swings his arm towards the voice coming from, but does not reach anyone.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Consciousness is fading… If things continue like this…)
(At that moment, a large flash of light appears in %s's vision.)
(Like a twinkling star breaking into pieces, things that were still in the falling light slowly move.)
(The lake's waves ripple again, and small leaves sway in the wind, and the pain that was constricting Adventurer's neck disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . ha… .
(Someone wearing a red robe slowly passes by %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda… ?
(The blonde elf woman tries to continue playing, but hesitates when someone's name comes out of Glinda's mouth.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy… … ?
… Don't call me that name! You called me that of your own accord and then killed me!!
I am Dorothea. It's Dorothea!!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy… . That's a mistake. It's a misunderstanding. Listen to me. That means... .
(As the woman who called herself Dorothea starts playing again, the surrounding scenery is filled with darkness coming from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What, what?)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy… . Stop, don't do this here. please… . This is a precious place to us. Those red shoes I bought you, you're still wearing them... .
(The moment Glinda extends her hand towards Dorothea, she suddenly becomes surprised.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Don't do this! You must not draw power from the cracks in the great wall!!
(The moment Glinda puts her hand on the sheath, flashes of light appear again around her. And a new scenery comes into view through the split pieces of light.)
(The fountain, which was filled with only plant stems and flowers, is now flowing water.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda… , Glinda, Glinda!!!!!!!
(Dorothea tries to continue playing again in anger, but her movements soon stop.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Are you going to ruin my bow now?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy, listen to me. At that time, you and I... … … .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I don't want to hear your voice anymore... . Glinda.
(As Dorothea turns her back, a black fog gathers from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Black fog?!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, close your eyes quickly!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? yes

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda, it's no use. I know you don't have much time left. I'll come back soon and stop the rest of your time with my performance.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Just like the day you stopped my life. In front of the emerald castle... … .
(As time passes without hearing anything or feeling anyone, %s's eyes naturally open.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is no one… . Where did they go?
(Water overflowing from the fountain is standing in front of %s, who was looking around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was said that it was a power drawn from a crack in the great wall... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did Glinda go? I need to find Glinda... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should we go to Mandarava? Bina said she knows everything on the way...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s go quickly… .

steps.name: Glinda's condition
steps.objective: Talk to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road”, pick up the <Repika's Potion Bottle> given by [Mandarava], and complete the quest at [Fountain].

lines.text: (Mandarava looks at the face of %s approaching and gets very angry.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: What did I say? Glinda, you said Glinda was sick. I asked you not to stay there for long. You did it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Glinda?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: When I caught him trying to chase Dorothy in there, he collapsed on the spot... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: First, I buried the herb in a place with good energy... . No, I laid it down… . I kept trying to stop him from getting up and I finally got him to fall asleep.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Witch Glinda, you have to be a little stubborn. If I didn't do this, I would have gone to Emeraldia and died.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava, tell me now. What happened to Glinda? You know everything.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Even if I know, I can't say it because I'm not the person involved. No. Ah, Glinda. Why wake up now! Lie down a little longer.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That can't be happening. Cluck, cluck. If it continues like this, everyone is in danger... . Cluck, cluck.
(Glynda chuckles and spits out blood from her mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda!!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda! Have you ever thought that if you do this, everyone will be in danger? Have you never tried it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda, don't be stubborn and take care of yourself first.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: … Cluck, cluck.
(Glynda does not respond and just sits down against the tree.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: … Glinda, you're going to die if you keep going like this.
(Mandarava, who was looking at Glinda, opens the zipper and drops something inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Empty bottle?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: This is not just a disease. This is an empty potion bottle that Lepika gave you to use wherever you need it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, the bottle is empty… .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Go ahead and throw this bottle in the fountain. Then, when it's full of water, take it out and bring it to you.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda needs that water. You need that water to recover a little.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It has special powers and if you drink it you will be able to say anything.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: This may not happen, but if you lose Lepika's potion bottle, please tell me again. I'll give you as much as you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, was that something like that? okay. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Please. %s. Oh, don't forget to close the lid.

steps.name: At the fountain of awakening
steps.objective: Obtain <Fountain of Memories> using the gathering skill at the fountain in “Oscar Road”. Then, report the quest to [Mandarava] in ‘Oscar Road’.

lines.text: (Throw Lepika's potion bottle into the fountain as Mandarava explained.)
(After a while, the empty potion bottle is filled with water. Then, when Adventurer closes the lid, the water inside the transparent potion bottle sparkles and emits light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's pretty. It feels like something full of light... . Ah, this is not the time to be like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go to Mandarava again.

steps.name: Dreamy Emeraldia
steps.objective:
1. Talk to “Oscar Road” and enter “Emeraldia”. 
2. Defeat [Dorothea] in “Emeraldia” and obtain the <Handkerchief of Sacrifice>. Then, return to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Good job.
(Mandarava opens the bottle of potion he received from %s and hands it to Glinda.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Come on, Glinda. Drink.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Drink if you don’t want to die like this. If you die like this, Dorothy, now transformed, will take your powers. You know, right?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Then the Dorothy village you so desperately want to protect could disappear.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Think about other people too. Even if we are adults, what are we going to do with Bina? .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Bina… .
(Glynda, who was repeating Bina's name in her mouth, nods as if she has made up her mind.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Got it, Mandarava. Cluck, cluck.
(Glynda suppresses a cough and struggles to wipe the blood from her mouth.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I didn't want to drink this until I died... .
(Glynda closes her eyes tightly and drinks the water from the potion bottle.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay now?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's okay for now. But, I don't know what will happen if I hear music again... … .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The spring water of memories is usually just water, but for some it can be good medicine. It is filled with the wish of someone who sacrificed himself to be remembered.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Mandarava, how much do you know? I think it's only been 10 years since I met you... . It was a long time ago when Dorothy... … .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Don't ask too much. You know. I am a spirit!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Yeah... , I get it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda… . Can I ask for a story?
(Glynda nods quietly.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When was it… .
(Glynda closes her eyes and traces her memories of the past.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: For a long time after the chaos of the sky, the continent was quite noisy in the name of reconstruction.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Alfheim's Lyosalf and Dorkalf also dreamed of a new future as they participated in the reconstruction of the continent.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: However, I heard stories of beings named witches appearing one by one on the continent and harming people.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: There was a girl who was living during that time. Like Bina, she was just a girl with lots of dreams and laughter. The girl believed that the story had nothing to do with her.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then at some point I found out. I instinctively felt that my destiny was different from others.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I wanted to live among ordinary elves... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then one day, night suddenly began, and an unknown witch led the girl by the hand, telling her to chase the night if she wanted anything.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I can't quite remember where, but there were a lot of women there from all over the place.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Among them, one girl caught my eye. She was a blonde elf girl with beautiful eyes. He said that this was his first time seeing someone from Lyosalf and led a girl in front of him, and that was Dorothy.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The conversation with Dorothy was very short, but it was a very good memory for the girl. Because two elf girls who wanted to live a normal life were able to share their feelings about suddenly becoming witches... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: We continue talking about everything from childhood habits to favorite things, and while playing on the cello that Dorothy brought... . Something happened.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Someone's voice echoed throughout the space. The moment when I felt the pain that tormented my ears, as well as the sadness and anger of the owner of the voice... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That was part of Walpurgis Night.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: One witch went crazy by that voice and started running wild, and the other witches fell to the floor bleeding... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The two girls, who had no idea what the witch's fate was until then, were so shocked that they had no choice but to run away. Then, unfortunately, the girl found out about her own abilities and that of someone else.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Really. ha… . I'm tired of being chased by other witches, but witch hunts have begun all over the continent.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Witches died, but non-witches were also caught up and killed. We stopped running when we saw the person we were helping dying.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I didn't want to live another day with the fate of being killed by someone... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: So the girl and Dorothy decided to become strong enough to protect each other, and when that reached a certain point, they decided to take a new path.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That's the girl. This is the story of me and Dorothy. For now, know this much.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That story about sex may not be true other than what I experienced.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If you cross the road seen between the trees, it is not the Etoire we know. It's a different world. To put it simply, it's like a demon world.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It was during the twilight years that Emeraldia first appeared in our world.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: In a world where gods disappeared, a road appeared that seemed to connect the demon world, and all living things became anxious.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: A group of courageous people gathered together to explore Emeraldia and met Oz, the black dragon who was the owner of the castle.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Oz said that he always swallowed the world connected to Emeraldia, and this time he swallowed the warriors, hoping that Etoire would become delicious food.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: However, the warriors cut open Oz's ship and came out, and the evil dragon grabbed the pierced ship and disappeared along with Emeraldia. I thought it wouldn't appear again after that... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Was it around 840? At that time, Dorothy and I were doing our own thing, avoiding witches and those who wanted to kill them.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I completely destroyed the doors to the demon world that appeared in Etoire, and sealed the doors that couldn't be broken down as much as possible.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Meanwhile, I heard a suspicious rumor. Children are going missing in Glaston and other areas.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then we were able to discover Emeraldia. Meanwhile, many children followed the light flowing from Emeraldia into the castle... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The children who came to their senses and did not try to enter were caught by the dragons and forcibly taken away.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Meanwhile, many knights and soldiers went in to rescue the children... . Most of them were swallowed up by Oz. Even if I came back alive, I couldn't come to my senses... … .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: We hurried to the Oscar Road to seal the entrance to Emeraldia... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The way I had done it, I couldn't do it with the strength I had. As I was feeling anxious, Dorothy spoke as if she had made a promise... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: To use my abilities. Does that make sense? I need to use my ability 'Encroach' to talk to Dorothy's spirit and make her a sacrifice for sealing... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: They said it couldn't be done and said they should find another way, but in the meantime, people were being dragged to death at an exponential rate.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Because I hesitated, Dorothy said she couldn't do it anymore and tried to kill me. They say that whoever dies will gain the power to seal Emeraldia... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I had to protect Dorothy... . The moment Dorothy took my sword and held it to my throat, I broke down.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: At that time, I had no choice but to do that... … .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy's magic and witch powers exploded, and Oz collapsed. I cut off its horns and head so it could no longer rise. I believed that was the end... … … .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I thought Dorothy's spirit could come back and save her... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: At that moment, the spirit of Oz emerged and rushed at me.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy, who saw this, pushed me out, but suddenly sharp thorns wrapped around Dorothy's face and her body, hurting everything. Maybe the eyes were back then... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When it was no longer possible to get closer because it was covered with thorns, the vivid emeraldia disappeared before my eyes... … .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That's the last we see of Emeraldia and Dorothy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, they built a village close to Oscar Road… .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Even though it disappeared, I continued to wait because I believed it was not dead.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If Dorothy had died... . If I had killed her, Dorothy's powers would have come to me.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That's not the case, that's why I waited until now. I thought I'd see you again someday... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I'm so funny. If I see it again, it means that Emeraldia has appeared again.
(Glynda's expression, after stopping her long story, looks somewhat relaxed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not funny... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Thank you… . Then I will continue the story. After that, I cut down all the evil energy here to prevent Emeraldia from appearing again for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Still, I did make room for Dorothy to come... , that was my mistake. Because Yongin came out in between.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If we leave it like this, everyone will be in danger... . The barrier that blocks the village can no longer withstand... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can do it. We have to protect everyone. Let me help you.
(Glynda quietly looks into %s's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Even if you really know, you don’t know. I could just pass by quietly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I know, I can't ignore it.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Maybe I have a similar personality to Iris, maybe not... . Hehehe.
(At that time, the sound of music that had not been heard for a while is heard again, and Glinda is in pain again.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. Cluck, cluck. Dorothy, please… . Stop it. please… … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda!! are you okay?!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: This is the performance you prepared for me, Dorothy... … … … .
(Glinda tries to laugh but then loses consciousness and falls down.)
(Mandarava, who was watching this, supports Glinda and makes her lean against the tombstone behind her.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: After listening to the story, it seems that Dorothea has many things wrong. Otherwise, there's no way he would play it with the intention of killing Glinda... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't think it will end with me meeting Dorothea... I will also see the dragon I met in the village again...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, wait… . Glinda told Dorothea that she shouldn't use the gap in the great wall... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't fully understand what's going on right now, but it will affect Iris too... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava, I will go inside the castle.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm sorry that the herb spirit couldn't help... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'm going because it might be something I should do. In the meantime, I'd like to ask Glinda for a favor.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Got it. Then prepare properly and go in.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Ah… . You're already gone... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Dorothea, Glinda… .
(As you walk along the path between two emerald trees, the surrounding scenery changes in an instant.)
(As the castle, which was only vaguely visible, is revealed, the blue lake that was in sight just a moment ago is completely gone.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Emeraldia… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This seems to be a castle, but how long is it? I can't see the end. Besides, why are there so many spiers... The remains of destroyed buildings are floating in the sky like empty space...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Dorothea? That… .
(%s's gaze, as he looked around, rests on a spire in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yong people… … .

(Adventurer steps back and raises his weapon to stand guard. Then Tip, who was leaning against the spire, jumps and falls forward. Tippeta next to him also spreads his wings and flies to where Adventurer is.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tip and Tippeta… … .

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Oh my, warrior. You remembered my name. I never thought we would meet again like this, but you came to see me, right? I'm so happy.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Does that sound come out when you die after being torn apart by a hero?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hehe, what do you think? That's from when Oz was alive.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Phew, my brother has all the bad taste in Oz.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Be quiet, Tip. Then you have the stupidity of Oz.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth are they talking about?)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Tippeta, let’s leave it at this. You have to prepare to welcome guests. Isn't it?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Because we have our jobs.
(Tifetta smiles brightly at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hero, welcome to Emeraldia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you calling me a warrior?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Are you asking because you don’t know? A hero fights to realize justice and save the world. I know that as a warrior. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: You shouted as you cut open Oz's stomach and pulled out its horns. He threatened me by saying that I would do the same thing if he showed up in Etoire again.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: But what should I do? We appeared in Etoire again, just like Oz back then.
(No sooner than Tippeta finishes speaking, Tip raises his sword and lunges at %s.)
(Adventurer is slightly surprised, but quickly calmly repels Tip's attack. He also avoids Tippeta's attack, which swings his mace in front of him.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Hoo. It's fun compared to back then. Shall we try a little more?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tip, let’s not do this here. There's no need to relax. Dorothea's song will soon be completed. Let's wait until then.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: It's starting to get fun... . Then there is nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tip, can I tell the hero about that? It doesn't matter if you tell me because I'm going to kill you anyway.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hero, we will become Oz again and destroy everything you love. That he would be reborn as an evil dragon to devour Etoire.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Dorothea's song will soon be completed.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: It's a beautiful song that will bring Glinda to pain and bring us back to Oz.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: If you play the cello with a bow made by melting down the horn of a high-ranking demon, Dorothea's spirit will disappear in favor.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: I'm sorry about that. I've been harassing you so much all this time. He captured Dorothea's spirit, which did not disappear even after her body died, and cursed Glinda.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Glinda killed Dorothea! He abandoned you for his own justice!!

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Without even knowing it, our poor Dorothea's soul wrote a song to kill her beloved Glinda.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: We even added a way to capture the resurrection of Oz. Ah, I'm so excited to think that the song is now complete.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You say something like that so casually... .

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Lux said she was going to deal with you in Glaston, but it looks like that didn't go well. Our time has passed so quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lux again...)
(At that time, a beautiful melody rings out from somewhere in Emeraldia.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is Dorothy’s….)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tip, let's go. There isn't much left now. There is no need to deal with the hero here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop right now.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: It's the time we've been waiting for so long, but do you think we'll stop by saying yes at your request?

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Tippeta. I changed my mind. That human, before we became Oz… .

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: He's a hero who's going to die anyway, so let's deal with him before that happens. It's not fun here, so let's wait and deal with it at the corner on the way.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Let's have fun after a long time.
(Tipetta grabs Tip's wrist and flaps her wings vigorously. Then, she rises into the air and sneers at Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hero. Don’t interfere with the completion of Dorothea’s masterpiece, “Emeraldia of Dreams.” Don't think about making your own intermission or something like that.
(With those words, Tippeta flies in the direction from where the sad music is heard, holding on to the tip.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dreamy Emeraldia... . It's a fitting title for Dorothea's performance, but all of this was already planned a long time ago... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is all about Lux… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't stay like this. I have to stop this playing with my own hands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s hurry… .
(The melody, filled with emotions of pain, sadness, and pain, becomes increasingly passionate.)
(The remnants, who have accepted the emotions that were fluctuating in Emeraldia, chase after Adventurer, but they all collapse before long.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . Why are there so many? It was hard to deal with Tip and Tippeta in the middle... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If you see that the playing sound is getting louder, are you ready?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The playing sound has stopped….)
(The moment Adventurer turns to the alley ahead, Dorothea is standing blankly looking at the sky of Emeraldia.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea… .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Please go back. This music is not for you. If you keep going like this, nothing will happen to you.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: If you play just a little more, the dreamy Emeraldia will be completed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, what do you want?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda's death... . That's all I need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When Glinda dies, the people, places and world you loved all fall apart.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: The moment Glinda's sword pointed at me, my life was already destroyed.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda pushed me into the thornbush to save herself. At that moment, I was blinded by the pain!!

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: How dare you look at these bandages wrapped around my face and say something like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, listen to me carefully. That's a false memory. Tip, Tippeta, and Yongin tricked you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The dragons used you to resurrect Oz. He captured your soul and made you hate Glinda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, we must stop here.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Tips? Tippeta? who is that? You're resurrecting Oz, the owner of this castle?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Oz-sama, Oz-sama is the person who saved me when I was dying. It makes no sense for Oz to die and be resurrected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, Glinda still misses you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because I can't forget you, I'm building a village named after you near Oscar Road.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, do you think Glinda killed you? He's the one who gave you the red shoes you're wearing now.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Red shoes?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda… .
(As Dorothea continues speaking, she holds her head with both hands as if something is strange.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I'm definitely on Glinda's sword... . No, I touched Glinda's sword... . Glinda got angry and... … .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Did you push it into a thorn bush? Glinda can't do that. Me, me... … … .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: We have been together for a long time... . I was trying to defeat the evil dragon Oz and seal the road... … … .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: … Which one is my memory... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm confused...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, come to your senses. uh?
(For a moment, Dorothea's body becomes blurred and then comes back.)
(Dorothea, who was confused, stares at Adventurer in a stiff posture.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea?
(At that moment, the air of Emeraldia surrounding Dorothea changes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… … .
(Adventurer hurriedly puts distance between himself and Dorothea and hurriedly raises his weapon.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: The completion of my song is not far away. No one can stop me from playing. I am… , I am… .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Dorothea, the witch of dreams... … … … .
(As Dorothea lifts her bow and strings the cello, all surrounding sounds are blocked.)
(And only “Emeraldia of Dreams,” which contains false feelings toward Glinda, resonates.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: … Now if you just play a little more, just a little more... .
(Dorothea defends against %s's attack, but the impact breaks her bow. She tries to play again with the broken bow, but all she hears is a loud noise.)
(Dorothea, who was listening to that sound, stops moving.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Why am I here playing like this? This isn't my music... … … . It's not me... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea?
(Tears flow through the bandage covering Dorothea's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: What am I for… until now… .
(Tipetta and Tip, who were not visible until a moment ago, appear above the head of Dorothea, who is sitting down with the cello.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: What are you doing? Dorothea!! Finish playing. There isn't much left to play!!

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: We even prepared a special bow for you. Kill Glinda with your playing, kill that man.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Oz?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Dorothea, we… . No, I'm Oz. This is Oz, who took care of you all these years. Well, keep playing. So... .

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Haha, it's really frustrating. How difficult is that? Bring what you’re holding to the string!!
(The moment Tip tries to snatch the bow Dorothea was holding, the movement stops.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Wow... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea… ?
(Tip falls down in pain, clutching the bow stuck in his chest.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tip, come to your senses!! tip!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea? Are you awake?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I misunderstood you and Glinda... . I found out too late that it was wrong... .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Without knowing that, I was deceived by those dragons and tried to connect Emeraldia and Etoire for a long time... .

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tips!! tip! tip… … ?
(Tip, who had lost consciousness in Tippeta's arms, slowly turns to dust and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Tippeta, you… . You might have thought that making a bow out of two high-ranking demon horns would complete the performance, but... . One of them was purified by Demigod.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I don't even know how a long time ago the hero dealt with an evil dragon that didn't seem to have any weaknesses.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: No way, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Since a long time ago, in Freios, evil dragons and dragons have been killed with the horns of purified demons. Oz from another world wouldn't know about it.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Oz, I remember you correctly now. Glinda cut off my head and pulled out my horns, but my spirit held on to me and wouldn't let me go... .

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: So you allowed your soul to stay here for a long time!!

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Tippeta, stop it now. You won't be able to last much longer either. It will take hundreds of years to be resurrected... .

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Wow!!
(When Tipetta, enraged by Dorothea's words, screams, the ominous energy in Emeraldia gathers around him.)
(As the light of Emeraldia is swallowed up by darkness, the area around the castle, where only the ruins remain, shakes violently.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, we have to get out of here.
(Adventurer reaches out and tries to grab Dorothea, but cannot be caught.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I'm already dead. Only the soul is bound here by Oz. No one can reach me except the remnants of Emeraldia.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: %s, hurry. The only moment you can leave Emeraldia is now. Go out there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you going to do Dorothea?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: If you go out, I'll send you a little luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. Then I will trust you and go out.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Thank you.
(Dorothea hears the footsteps of %s going outside, avoiding Tippeta's angry attack.)
(And then he touches his wet eyes and stares into space.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: The one who awakened my memories was a witch... . After all, you need my ‘sacrifice’ ability, right?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Okay. Then promise me one thing. Okay, thank you. I feel your heart too. A heart for a precious person, that alone is enough.
(A new bow appears in front of Dorothea, as if someone had given it to her as a gift.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Hello, Emeraldia. Hello, Oz.
(Dorothea takes her stance again and begins to play. The lonely melody, which felt sadness, pain, and even pain, suddenly changes into joy, happiness, and warmth.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Dorothea, no!! Stop!!
(The moment Tippeta, who was chasing Adventurer, hurriedly runs to Dorothea, the green light that filled Emeraldia turns into a shadow and covers everyone.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Stop… … … .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Oz, I will now wake up from my dream and disappear. Now, “Emeraldia of Dreams” is for you, not Glinda.

steps.name: gift left behind
steps.objective: Talk to [Mandarava] in “Oscar Road” and report the quest to [Runo] in “Dorothy Village.”

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, catch it quickly!! Don’t say anything and just hold on!!
(Mandalaba suddenly appears in front of %s, who was running towards Oscar Road.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I don't have time!! Emeraldia is dying!! If it continues like this, everyone in this area will disappear!!
(Mandarava quickly pulls a thread from his side and wraps it around Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Spirits of the wind. Blow, blow harder!! Fuuuuu, blow!
(Then a strong wind blows from somewhere and blows away Mandaraba and Adventurer in an instant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow! Flying! No, it's falling!
Light.
(When I came to my senses and looked ahead, Adventurer was lying face down on the mandalaba.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, look over there.
(The road to Emeraldia between the trees becomes blurry. The emerald castle looking at this place from afar also gradually collapses and becomes blurry.)
(And even the demonic beasts that were chasing Adventurer stop moving and gradually fade away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everything is gone... .
(Only the trees that grew on what used to be a road remain, swaying in the blowing wind, and there are no traces of Emeraldia anywhere.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Then again, Dorothea... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right… .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Tell me what happened inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. that is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Mandarava what happened in Emeraldia.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's fortunate that Dorothea came to her senses... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda, are you okay?
(Glynda is still lying unconscious on one side.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It looks okay now, but after using a lot of power to stop Emeraldia for a long time, it wouldn't be strange if he died at any time... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: If we leave it like this, Glinda will definitely... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Dorothy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothy?
(Adventurer looks back at Mandarava's surprised expression. Dorothea is seen looking for the fallen Glinda.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Spirit… , long time no see. By the way, where is Glinda... … … ?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I don't have time... . There's only a little left of what was in Emeraldia, so I can't feel Glinda... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea… .
(Adventurer reaches out for Dorothea, but the hand passes right by.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's okay if it's me. Dorothea, here you go. Glinda falls asleep for a moment.
(Dorothea, whose body was blurry and then back to normal, reaches out and grabs the mandaraba. Then she finds Glinda next to her.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I'm sorry... .
(Mandarava helps Glinda up and leans against a nearby rock. Dorothea then reaches out and gently hugs Glinda.)
(However, it cannot be touched by Dorothea in her soul state.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda, I wanted to see your face... . I wanted to feel your warmth too... .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: It was a decision I made for myself at that time. I guess I got scared for a moment. I was afraid. I was scared… . Still, I said it was something I had to do... .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Suddenly, Oz found a crack in my soul and led me to Emeraldia. Without knowing that a part of my soul was swallowed up... .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: For a long time, I misunderstood you as if it were the truth in a false dream... .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I'm sorry... . I've tormented you for a long time... . But, it'll be okay now. Glinda. I… .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy?
(At that moment, Glinda opens her eyes and reaches out to touch Dorothea's face. However, the hand only passes by Dorothea, who is vaguely visible.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Ah… … .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I was going to go before you woke up... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Going… . Now that we've met, where are we going? Dorothy… . I'm here.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I can't... . From the moment Oz caught me, my soul was bound to a nightmare.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I wonder how I can somehow place your soul somewhere else... .

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Don't do that, Glinda. If you keep doing that, it won't be worthwhile for me to deal with Oz.
(As Dorothea gently smiles, the color gradually fades, as if looking away.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: After a little bit of Emeraldia's remaining light, it will all disappear. With this, Etoire will feel better to some extent.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda, you need to be okay now. That's my wish.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Just like you held my hand and helped me escape the night, someday I will hold your hand again. here
(With those words, Dorothea disappears and can no longer be seen.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy! Dorothy… … .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy… … … .
(Glynda reaches out and tries to embrace the remaining light, but the light cannot be captured. Only the red shoes that Dorothea was wearing remain in their place.)
(Mandarava approaches %s, who was watching from behind.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, let's go back to town.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Glinda?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda won't be sick anymore. Dorothy's abilities allowed Glinda's life to continue. And it seems like that ability has been passed on to other witches.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… … … .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's a witch's fate... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Let's go now. I have to tell Runo, who is waiting for Glinda... .

steps.name: As if nothing happened
steps.objective: Talk to [Runo] in “Dorothy Village” and report the quest to [Vina] in “Dorothy Village”.

lines.text: (As soon as they enter the village, Runo runs and catches Mandarava.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Mandarava, where is the boss now?!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda is not sick anymore. It's okay.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Really... .

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: See you soon boss... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wait, Runo. Glinda needs time. Just like Glinda gave you time... .

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I understand.
(As Runo lets down his guard, his red eyes return to their original state.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: %s… , I was sorry. I couldn't follow the boss' orders.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Nothing much happened in the village, right?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Nothing much happened. I was fully prepared in case those dragons came back.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Fortunately, the villagers didn't seem to notice either. Oh, Elliot knew…

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Elliot is good at keeping his worries secret, so it’s okay.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: There are just a lot of tears, but he is stronger and cooler than anyone else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty and Bina?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: The two of them went in to explore the warehouse. How many hours has it been already? I'm watching because I heard the cooking is okay.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s okay… . It's just that I'm a little low on stamina.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You look tired. %s. It would be best to rest. Emeraldia is a completely different world, so just getting there would have been difficult, but it was too much... .

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Ah!
(Mandarava opens the zipper and takes out a herb from inside. Seeing it struggling with a smile, it seems to be a happy mandrake.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'll stun you for a moment, so just wait. If you swallow this, the recovery effect is enormous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, I'll decline. Just need to sleep a little and wake up... .

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Yeah. Go and rest. Leave the rest to us.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Us?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: You are also from Dorothy Village.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's a spirit... .

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: My mouth hurts even if I talk about it. I get it. Then, Mandarava, go get some rest.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Thank you, Runo. I'll sunbathe on the roof and watch to see if Glinda comes. %s, you go in and rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Mandarava. Oh, see you later, Runo, too.
(As soon as Adventurer heads towards the accommodation, Mandarava also rises to the roof of the cat-shaped house.)
(However, not long after, it comes back down to where Runo is.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Why are you coming down already?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda is coming with a guest. Come together.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Guest? The boss didn't say anything like that... .

steps.name: daydream
steps.objective: Talk to [Vina] in “Dorothy Village” and go to [Glinda]. And when all the conversations are over, report the quest to [Glinda].

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: %s!! Are you alive?!
(Vina stretches and is surprised to see %s coming out of the dorm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Do you think it’s been a few days since you woke up? no. Do you know? Meow? You sleep more than a cat or a beastman!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? I don’t think I slept for a few hours… .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Already, already!! Meow. I heard you slept for a week! No matter how much I want to sleep, I can't sleep like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To sleep for a week... . But no one woke you up?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I was already thinking that Leti was dead, so I poked her twice a day, but she just snored and wouldn't wake up, so I gave up.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: My mom even told me to just leave it alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … When did Glinda come?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Are you saying you went to meet a friend?  He said it was nice to meet a friend after such a long time.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nyaha. I love seeing my mom smile so happily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: %s, I, Leti, and I are going to explore the warehouse again. Would you like to come with us? Elliot next time. They say you need to mentally prepare.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go see Glinda, so I'll go with her later. Oh, now that I think about it, how did it come out?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Bunny Bunny took me outside because it was noisy. Ah, who is Bunny Bunny? There was a ghost story protagonist last time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Bunny Bunny Luceria.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Hehe, that's right. I was shaking because I was scared, but Leti went first and kept talking to me.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: When I gathered up the courage to talk about my mom, they listened with interest. It was so cute how he got so upset when I told him that if he bothered me, he would get back to his mom. Meow

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, you will really like Glinda... .

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: The time has already come to this. Nyahahaam. I'm a little sleepy, but it's okay. See you later, %s. lol.
(Vina says hello to %s and quickly runs towards the Munchkin warehouse.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Bina! Don't come late to explore the warehouse. Come out early! Okay? As promised, Elliot is later!

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Yes mom!!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Haha. I don't want to nag you, but I'm playing with Luceria... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Did you sleep well? I thought he was dead because he didn't show any signs of waking up for a week.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are saying the same thing as Bina.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Yeah? Are you feeling okay? Since I went to Emeraldia, it wouldn't have been surprising if I collapsed right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I'm glad if you don't mind... . Oh, I want to talk to you for a moment. Would you like to come over here?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Thank you.
(Glinda makes tea made with good herbs in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Thanks to you, I realized my foolish mistakes. He was tying himself up in the name of protecting the village... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did I do?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: No. You are a benefactor to me and our village.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: At first, I thought he was just a human being blessed by Iris, but that wasn't the case. You are a bigger person than that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you're okay.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I'm fine. Even if it's not okay, I'll make it okay. Otherwise Dorothy would be disappointed, right? Because my life was reconnected because of Dorothy.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, I won't stay hidden anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is that... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I don't know about other witches, but I think I need to go out a little bit now. If it stays like this, nothing will change.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I came to this in order to face the fate given by the Goddess of the Black Moon... . That wouldn't be bad either.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: And I will help you without any conditions. Considering the faithfulness you have shown me, it is only natural that I repay you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda, thank you for your words... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You helped me wake up from a sad dream covered in darkness. When I say this, I mean it, so accept it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… , I will.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, what do you do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to rest in the village and find out Pandora's whereabouts.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It won't be easy if Daphne is with you. Daphne's thinking itself is different from ordinary people.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: There are two witches next to Daphne right now. Circe and Pandora. I don't know how Daphne plans to use these two, but... .

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I will continue to look into it for you. It might take some time, but why not work with someone you have a connection with?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Someone you have a connection with? who?
(With those words, someone taps %s on the shoulder with something like a cane.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, what about this wand?
(When Adventurer turns around, a familiar woman smiles and withdraws her cane.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea… ?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, how are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you get here? But that outfit... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When Shinik heard that there was work to do on another continent, he joined Io and requested clothes from a person named Chrysien. ha… . I had no choice… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In Freios?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So, I'm going to tell you from now on. About the ‘something’ Daphne left behind… … .
